market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $108 oil, 3.4% sticky CPI, and Fed hike probability. Expect volatility in equities, especially rate-sensitive and consumer discretionary. Energy and defense outperform. Mortgage rates above 7% pressure housing. Bitcoin below $77K signals risk-off. 'Face-ripper rally' possible on any de-escalation but base case is choppy, range-bound tape.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Oracle, Anthropic, Ciena) supports tech leadership through 2027. Higher-for-longer rates favor income strategies (CDs, dividend growers like HSY, MRK). Geopolitical multipolarity (BRICS, India pivot) reshapes trade flows. Energy transition (Europe solar storage gap) creates infrastructure opportunities. Consumer value shift is structural, not cyclical.
